# Filter the dataset for Psychology studies that were replicated
psychology_replicated_studies = df[(df['project'] == 'ml3') & (df['replicated'] == 1)]

# Count the number of junior professors in these studies
# Assuming 'seniority.o' and 'seniority.r' indicate the seniority of the original and replication study authors
# We will consider 'Assistant' and 'Researcher' as junior professors
junior_professors_count = psychology_replicated_studies[(psychology_replicated_studies['seniority.o'] == 'Assistant') | (psychology_replicated_studies['seniority.o'] == 'Researcher') | (psychology_replicated_studies['seniority.r'] == 'Assistant') | (psychology_replicated_studies['seniority.r'] == 'Researcher')].shape[0]

# Count the total number of replicated Psychology studies
total_replicated_studies = psychology_replicated_studies.shape[0]

# Calculate the proportion of junior professors
proportion_junior_professors = junior_professors_count / total_replicated_studies
